description: Model registry — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tag -> model_id. A `tag` is the short alias used across local files and the plugin (agent `.md` frontmatter `model: <tag>`); `model_id` is the real Claude model string, used both to invoke the model and for telemetry. To bump a model, edit it HERE — do not restate model IDs elsewhere (README/CORE-TODO/SKILL link here). `pipeline_tiers` lists the tags the pipeline actually dispatches and that hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh enforces (mirror of its is_valid_tier list — keep in sync); the remaining `models` entries are reference/pin-only. Pricing (input/output per MTok, for telemetry cost) is a planned next step and intentionally omitted for now.
